newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CBA cuts business, mortgage rates.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CBA cuts business, mortgage rates.

text.p: Commonwealth Bank of Australia said on Wednesday that it would cut its corporate loan reference rate to 9.25 percent from 9.75 percent and its standard home loan variable mortgage rate to 8.25 percent from 8.75 percent.

CBA said the cut in the corporate rate will be effective from January 28 next year and the new mortgage rate will be effective from December 12, 1996, for new borrowers and January 28, 1997 for existing borrowers.
The bank said it will also cut its overdraft and loan index rate for commercial borrowers to 9.75 percent from 10.25 percent, which is also effective from January 28.
It said it will also cut its Economiser base variable rate home loan to 7.35 percent from 7.85 percent, effective December 12, for new borrowers and January 28 for existing borrowers.

Commonwealth and Westpac Banking Corp are the only two of Australia's four major banks to cut business lending rates, following the Reserve Bank of Australia's (RBA) cut in official cash rates by 0.5 percentage points to 6.0 percent.
